decontamination_notes: Real fix from tobymao/sqlglot PR #8161, merged 2026-08-14, after model training cutoffs, so the specific fix is novel. Repo sliced at the PR's base commit 16cd8d7 (sqlglot package + MIT LICENSE + setup.py); dependency-free, runs on the base sandbox image with PYTHONPATH=.. The bug: the optimizer normalized (lower-cased) field names in semi-structured dot access (MAP/VARIANT/JSON), which is a case-sensitive data lookup, the same way it normalizes STRUCT field identifiers. Hidden tests assert the public qualify+annotate_types output SQL string for MAP/VARIANT (must preserve case) vs STRUCT (still normalized), lifted from the upstream test. Run with -c /dev/null so the repo's pytest config is ignored.
